name: Chiang Mai
summary: Large plant-based scene and many vegetarian Thai options.
planningNote: Starter rating; verify current venues before booking.

name: Bangkok
summary: Very broad choice, including Thai, international and fully vegan venues.
planningNote: Starter rating; verify current venues before booking.

name: Phuket
summary: Good choice in major beach areas and Phuket Town.
planningNote: Availability varies strongly by district.

name: Singapore
summary: Dense mix of vegetarian food courts, Indian food and modern vegan dining.
planningNote: Starter rating; check opening hours and prices.

name: Kuala Lumpur
summary: Strong Indian, Chinese vegetarian and modern plant-based options.
planningNote: Starter rating; verify current venues before booking.

name: George Town
summary: Good vegetarian heritage-food options and a compact centre.
planningNote: Ask about egg, dairy, fish sauce and shrimp paste.

name: Ho Chi Minh City
summary: Many chay restaurants plus a growing modern vegan scene.
planningNote: Chay can be vegan or vegetarian; confirm ingredients.

name: Hanoi
summary: Numerous chay restaurants, especially around central districts.
planningNote: Chay can be vegan or vegetarian; confirm ingredients.

name: Da Nang
summary: Good value chay restaurants and an easy-to-navigate centre.
planningNote: Starter rating; verify current venues before booking.

name: Hoi An
summary: Tourist-oriented restaurants make dietary requests relatively easy.
planningNote: Ask explicitly about fish sauce and egg.

name: Ubud
summary: High concentration of plant-based cafés and wellness-oriented food.
planningNote: Often pricier than local warungs.

name: Canggu
summary: Many modern vegan and vegetarian cafés.
planningNote: Traffic and prices can be significant trip factors.

name: Yogyakarta
summary: Good local vegetarian choices and affordable student-city dining.
planningNote: Ask about shrimp paste, egg and dairy.

name: Jakarta
summary: Large overall choice, but venues are spread across a very large city.
planningNote: Plan around neighbourhood and travel time.

name: Manila
summary: Growing vegan scene, especially in central business and lifestyle districts.
planningNote: Venues are dispersed; transport time matters.

name: Cebu City
summary: A useful base with a smaller but workable plant-based selection.
planningNote: Research neighbourhoods before choosing accommodation.

name: Phnom Penh
summary: Good international choice and several dedicated vegetarian venues.
planningNote: Ask about fish sauce, egg and dairy.

name: Siem Reap
summary: Tourism infrastructure supports a good range of dietary options.
planningNote: Central areas are easiest without private transport.

name: Luang Prabang
summary: Some vegetarian-friendly cafés and guesthouses in a compact centre.
planningNote: Choice is more limited than in regional capitals.

name: Vientiane
summary: A modest selection of vegetarian and international restaurants.
planningNote: Verify current opening hours.

name: Yangon
summary: Traditional vegetarian options exist, but trip conditions require separate checking.
planningNote: Verify current travel advisories and venue availability.
